description:
Hushfeed v0.30.2 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

GIF conversion now proves each deadline checkpoint independently, and Logger contains hostile exception text. Comment tools resolves every native anchor and register before changing an APK. Selector checks catch inherited methods and Java binary class names earlier. False Lazy AB matches now fail as well. Settings journal recovery, Video Fit handoff, device replacement and release verification now report failures at the contract that changed.

Validation: 1054 runtime tests passed locally, plus 139 in the patches module. The bundle carries 71 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
